verdict.rationale: Mintlify documents and exposes a public REST API for triggering deployments, embedding the assistant, and exporting analytics (mintlify-docs-21), alongside CLI, MCP servers, and markdown/llms.txt endpoints that let AI-native users drive the product programmatically; runtime probes confirm several of these are live (mintlify-probe-rt-1 through rt-5). missing for 10: no independent/third-party corroboration of the REST API itself (only first-party docs), and the openapi.json spec for that REST API returned 404 in probing, leaving its exact surface unverified.
